title: Allowance Authority Schedule: Late Delivery Credits and Transit Damage Allowances
content:
This schedule sets the figures the desk works to on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment when the
goods arrive late or arrive marked. The grace days are the days past the promised day before the late credit is paid.
The late credit is the credit paid when the goods miss the promised day. The damage window is the days after delivery
within which transit damage must be reported. The damage allowance is the allowance offered for cosmetic transit
damage the customer accepts, as a percentage of the line.

| Fulfilment service | Grace days past the promised day | Late delivery credit | Damage reported within, days after delivery | Damage allowance, percent of the line |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 2 | 0.00 | 2 | 10 |
| Store Pickup Hold | 0 | 0.00 | 2 | 10 |
| Threshold Delivery | 1 | 25.00 | 2 | 15 |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 1 | 35.00 | 2 | 15 |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 1 | 75.00 | 3 | 20 |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 2 | 150.00 | 5 | 15 |

## The damage allowance worked through (hypothetical line value)

The damage allowance is a percentage of the line. On Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away, whose allowance is 15
percent, a line of 1200.00 gives 180.00; on White Glove Delivery and Installation, whose allowance is 20 percent, the
same line gives 240.00; on Standard Parcel Delivery, whose allowance is 10 percent, it gives 120.00.

## Notes on the two credit columns

Standard Parcel Delivery and Store Pickup Hold carry a late credit figure of 0.00. The figure rises with the crew and
the carriage: 25.00 on Threshold Delivery, 35.00 on Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away, 75.00 on White Glove
Delivery and Installation and 150.00 on Business Dock and Freight Delivery. The grace figure is 0 days on collection,
1 day on the three two-person services and 2 days on the parcel and freight services.
